marketing hero (web): left-aligned two-line grotesque display headline (white line / lime line), ~45ch subtitle, one filled primary CTA + ghost secondary, 6-item top nav with single lime Download button

signature_moves: Monospace as the metadata voice: uppercase-tracked mono eyebrows + tabular mono time values against a grotesque display sans — tracked time reads as instrument/stopwatch output
One acid accent (#D6FF3A) + exactly one data second-hue (#FF945C coral); disciplined Von-Restorff colour economy
Depth by lightness step (#050603 -> #1A1A1D), shadowless, hairline borders that barely register
defects: Contrast Dilution (minor) — secondary mono labels ~#8E8E8E on #1A1A1D card ≈ 4:1, under 4.5:1 text floor
UI-contrast miss — hairline borders #232324 on #1A1A1D <3:1 (decorative only; fill step carries separation)
Genericness risk — 'dark neutral + one electric/acid accent' is the unprompted dev-tool default; earned back here by the mono/sans contrast pairing and single-second-hue discipline
Evidence/positioning gap (not a design defect) — sold as 'a native Mac timer' but no native macOS chrome appears in any supplied asset

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (Linear/Vercel row) crossed with Terminal/hacker — drenched near-black ground, one acid-lime accent, monospace metadata, grotesque display sans; dials ~V5/M4/D3

psychology: Von Restorff effect — single acid-lime is the one saturated element (CTA, RUNNING state, top series); it is remembered because almost nothing else is coloured
Aesthetic-Usability effect (Kurosu & Kashimura) — high-contrast, coherent dark composition buys a perceived-quality halo before any interaction
Signal detection / CTA prominence — the lime Download button breaks the monochrome nav pattern, making the one action trivially locatable
Serial-position / F-pattern — meaning front-loaded top-left ('Time in. Invoice out.') where the eye lands first
Hick's Law — 6-item nav (<=7) and one primary CTA per region keep decision points simple
Self-monitoring (Fogg) — RUNNING pill + live ticking timer surface state continuously (product-concept card, not marketing)
notes: MARKETING-ONLY EVIDENCE. cover.png is a web landing-page composite; the three 'app' surfaces are chrome-less product-concept cards embedded in the hero and cut off at the fold — no macOS window, traffic lights, toolbar, sidebar, menu bar, or system materials appear anywhere. Lineage of the actual app is therefore unverifiable (recorded unknown/low); the native-tells audit is inapplicable (score 0, not a failing native app but simply no native surface to judge). Nothing here may feed macOS canon or native clusters — file as brand/concept evidence only. icon.png was supplied (flat full-square lime #D6FF3A ground + bold black geometric 'A' monogram, no squircle mask / gloss / depth layers — a web brand mark, non-native as an app icon) and reinforces the identity, but a full Workflow-B icon digest was out of scope for this pass and is deferred. Scale of the composite is ~2x and unconfirmed, so all sizes/radii are (estimated) with wide ranges. To classify this app properly the synthesis pass should request a real native-window screenshot (main timer window, Settings, or menu-bar extra).
